Films 'Alpha' and 'Welcome To The Jungle' compete at box office

Several Indian films are currently competing at the box office, with 'Alpha' and 'Welcome To The Jungle' being prominent. 'Alpha', starring Alia Bhatt and Sharvari, is nearing a Rs 75 crore worldwide collection. Meanwhile, 'Welcome To The Jungle' is also performing strongly, with some reports indicating it is posing a challenge to 'Alpha'. Other films like 'Cocktail 2' are also mentioned in box office reports.
